title: Bahla Fort

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the southwestern rock-foot approach, outside the standing curtain. The native field fixes each curtain segment’s stone base.

identities.name: Bahla Fort
identities.address: Bahla Fort, Bahla, Ad Dakhiliyah Governorate, Sultanate of Oman

mapIdentity.scope: Current mapped fort boundary registers the occupied platform. Nineteenth-century photographs show the tower taper and relationship to the enclosure. Original Copernicus data fixes elevation at the southwestern foot of the enclosure.

note: Miles’s original plates constrain the rubble footing, large earthen curtain, rounded wind tower, tall arched gallery, flat roofs and irregular parapets. Official heritage records identify the three building groups.
